## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//thrift:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//thrift:defs.bzl", "thrift_library")
```

## Rules

### `thrift_library`

Owns Apache Thrift schemas for dx lint. Includes resolve only from deps, relative to the including file or from the workspace root.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | Thrift schema files of this package. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | thrift_library targets whose schemas these include. |
